claims: The Los Angeles Dodgers open the 2026 MLB season at home against the Arizona Diamondbacks.
The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener is on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener is at 5:30 p.m. PT.
The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener is at Dodger Stadium, Los Angeles, CA.
The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener will feature a 2025 championship banner raising.
Yoshinobu Yamamoto is starting on the mound for the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener.
Tickets for the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 opening day matchup have reached record-high prices.
The broadcast for the Los Angeles Dodgers Opening Day is NBC/Peacock.
Dave Roberts announced the pitching rotation following Opening Day.
Dave Roberts announced Yoshinobu Yamamoto for Thursday, March 26.
Dave Roberts announced Emmet Sheehan for Friday, March 27.
Dave Roberts announced Tyler Glasnow for Saturday, March 28.
Dave Roberts announced Roki Sasaki for Monday, March 30.
Dave Roberts announced Shohei Ohtani for Tuesday, March 31.
TickPick reported the Los Angeles Dodgers' opening day game as the most expensive regular-season game on record.
